answer: Make each agent pass a bond-backed work trial before rewards. It locks 25 tokens, draws a random task, signs its result, and gets three peer reviews; an auditor checks a sample. Honest work returns the bond and builds reputation, while copied proofs burn it and suspend linked identities for 10 rounds. A farm of 500 fakes ties up 12,500 tokens and owes 1,500 reviews before claiming rewards. A public kernel of signed hashes exposes duplicates: aliases may spiral and ripple through the network, but they cannot turn one proof into many trusted agents at scale.
